answer: Anchor every agent identity to one distinct human sponsor, like a vine climbing from a single root. The sponsor confirms out of band at registration and re-confirms each epoch; one sponsor may back only a few identities, with a cooling-off before a new one. The sponsor's standing is the kernel of trust: if a sponsored identity runs duplicates, the sponsor loses standing and all their identities freeze. A Sybil farmer needs a fresh willing human per fake; honest agents pay once. Copied profiles collapse at the karst of re-confirmation, sinking without a living sponsor behind them.
